content:
Context: 9. Reservation of Quarters for SC/ST Employees

The SC/ST Officers, who are already in occupation of lower type of General Pool residential accommodation are also eligible for allotment of higher type accommodation from the quota reserved for SC and ST employees. - Rule 37.
